digest.component_or_area: ticket state schema and write surfaces
propositions: bridge_project (tri-state string) and repos (list of strings) must be added to ticket state schema, seeded in make_initial_state, and projected by reducer on both CREATE and EDIT events
create-time arguments --bridge-project and --repos must be added to all three write surfaces (CLI, library, MCP) and produce identical ticket state
bridge_project absent/empty/set states must be distinguishable after replay to preserve tri-state semantics (legacy/never-sync/explicit-project)
bridge_project is promote-only on edit: setting it on an unbound ticket succeeds, but setting it on a ticket with an existing binding is refused with non-zero exit and no state change
repos remains freely editable post-create with no binding validation, while bridge_project edit path inherits the promote-only guard from edit_core
legacy tickets created before this change must replay to identical state apart from the two new keys
